name: Alther's Mill

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you know Lakeshire needs its bridge rebuilt, but constant threats keep drawing resources away from the work.

faq.answer: Foreman Oslow is the stonemason overseeing repairs and rebuilding of the bridge in Lakeshire. Local threats keep delaying his work.
Alther's Mill is a lumber mill east of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. Its timber shipments supply construction around Lakeshire, including the bridge.
Alther operates the lumber mill east of Lakeshire. Foreman Oslow holds him responsible for managing the site, now overrun by spiders.
Foreman Oslow cannot safely send workers to gather lumber while tarantulas infest the mill. Clearing the spiders and destroying their eggs lets timber deliveries for the bridge resume safely.
faq.q: Why does Foreman Oslow need Alther's Mill cleared?

faq.answer: Greater tarantulas and clutches of spider eggs infest the mill, threatening any workers sent to collect lumber.
Foreman Oslow is rebuilding the bridge in Lakeshire. Hostile orcs, gnolls, murlocs, and local pests that threaten lumber supplies keep delaying the work.
faq.q: What bridge is Foreman Oslow trying to build?

sections.body: Foreman Oslow is trying to keep bridge repairs on schedule in Lakeshire. Blackrock orcs, gnoll packs, and murlocs along Lake Everstill already strain his workforce. Now giant tarantulas have overrun Alther's Mill to the east, stopping the timber shipments the bridge needs.
sections.title: A Bottleneck in Lumber

sections.body: Spiders lurk among the timber stacks, leaving the mill useless. Foreman Oslow cannot risk sending laborers into a nest of greater tarantulas, so he hires capable adventurers to clear the spiders and destroy their egg clutches. He is irritated that Alther let the mill fall into disarray, but Lakeshire needs the lumber before the bridge work can continue.
sections.title: Clearing the Infestation

summary: Workers at Alther's Mill cannot send timber to Lakeshire while giant spiders overrun the eastern lumberyard. Foreman Oslow needs the wood to finish the town bridge.
